subject.why: The subject is clearly a red twin-bell alarm clock with bells, hammer, legs, and ringing effect marks.

category.why: The clock floats at a three-quarter tilted angle without ground or surface, set against concentric purple rings.

clean.why: The clock face contains clock numbers (1–12), violating the strict rule against numbers and text.

framing.why: The clock is centered with sufficient margins on all sides and nothing is cut off.

colour.why: The red clock contrasts clearly against the vivid purple background, and the palette is bright and saturated.

detail.why: The volumes are chunky and simplified without micro-textures, scratches, or unnecessary clutter.

style.why: Rendered with smooth volumes, clean satin materials, and soft lighting matching the reference style.

fix: Remove the numbers from the clock face to keep it clean and minimal.
